svg.title: Curry District — Handled bag 10×5×13 in · dieline sheet (indicative) (B · Royal)
svg.desc: Curry District · Brand Glow-Up concept artwork (independent design proposal, not official material). Units: 100 = 1 inch.
svg.text: B · Royal · flat sheet ≈ 30.75 × 18 in · white kraft · flexo · twisted paper handles
Gusset centre creases fold inward; the bottom flaps form a square base. Handles: twisted paper, glued to inside patches.
Concept dieline for pitching only — request the converter’s own dieline PDF and a printed proof before ordering.
